==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I had multiple creative ideas in my dream. One idea was for a library that requires you to write and publish commentary based on what you check out. All published commentary then becomes available in said library for others to check out.

I actually really like this idea. It would allow for the library to grow exponentially. Every patron would become their own author.

This also could lead to a meta rabbit hole of books about books about books. This might be somewhat difficult to implement in physical libraries. I do think it could be possible to do this digitally though.
